The variation-of-constants formula on bounded complete trajectories proves the compact-recurrence half-space and pointwise bounds. The invariant-measure identity follows from \(\int LR\,d\mu=0\) on compact support, and the physical-variable statement is the same chain-rule identity. No numerical trajectory is used to infer an infinite-time statement.

value.rationale: The source is built around long-time periodic and chaotic regimes. Converting its nonlinear memory state to an exact positive stable filter yields a natural global constraint on every compact recurrent state, an explicit phase-space exclusion and bound, and an exact stationary observable calibration useful for simulation/hardware consistency. This is materially stronger than re-evaluating an equilibrium or a finite trajectory.
